en: Little guelder rose, little guelder rose, my little guelder rose!
In the garden a berry, a little raspberry, my little raspberry!
Ah, under the pine, under the green one,
Lay me down to sleep!
Ai-liuli, liuli, ai-liuli, liuli,
Lay me down to sleep.
Little guelder rose, little guelder rose, my little guelder rose!
In the garden a berry, a little raspberry, my little raspberry!
Ah, little pine tree, you green one,
Do not rustle above me!
Ai-liuli, liuli, ai-liuli, liuli,
Do not rustle above me!
Little guelder rose, little guelder rose, my little guelder rose!
In the garden a berry, a little raspberry, my little raspberry!
Ah, beauty, sweetheart maiden,
Do love me!
Ai-liuli, liuli, ai-liuli, liuli,
Do love me!
Little guelder rose, little guelder rose, my little guelder rose!
In the garden a berry, a little raspberry, my little raspberry!
rom: V sadu jagoda malinka, malinka moja!
V sadu jagoda malinka, malinka moja!
V sadu jagoda malinka, malinka moja!
V sadu jagoda malinka, malinka moja!
notes: Romanization: х is written x, ь ʹ, ё ë, й j.
line 1.1: 'калинка' is a diminutive of 'калина', the guelder rose (snowball tree) and its red berries; 'малинка' a diminutive of 'малина', raspberry. Both are terms of endearment.
line 2.3: 'ай-люли, люли' are lullaby syllables with no meaning.
